title: Event Runtime integration boundary
summary: NORM descriptor readiness projects through the common SocketProvider contract; a transport-neutral Socket/Event Runtime adapter converts known-ready provider listeners into typed SOCKET.ACCEPTED events without moving fd polling into Event Runtime.
invariants: Event Runtime v0.1-dev1 owns typed registration and dispatch, not fd polling or provider I/O.
The adapter consumes only the common listener descriptor, waitReady and tryAccept contract; it has no NORM API dependency.
A scheduler may watch the descriptor and call drainReady after readiness; the adapter then drains nonblocking and emits SOCKET.ACCEPTED through EventSource.
The accepted socket remains the Event data object by identity and is not flattened into bytes or a map.
Removing an adapter registration does not close the provider listener or leave multicast membership.
SocketDescriptorSet can hold multiple descriptors and dispatch one known-ready descriptor independently; it does not poll/select them.

The implementation candidate is packages/oorexx_socket_event_runtime_adapter_v0.1-dev1; NORM dev3 remains the live-qualified transport baseline until this adapter is independently executed under ooRexx.
